description: PRISM scheduled cron jobs registry. Each entry names a script + cron expression; the cron-bootstrap loader translates to platform scheduler.

jobs.description: Compose 3-connections + 1-pattern + 1-question brief from inbox/memories/wiki-log; written to knowledge/memories/inbox/brief-YYYY-MM-DD.md.

Walk H:/Resources/ for new/touched files (mtime > last-scan-ts); emit one inbox marker per file at knowledge/memories/inbox/resources-<slug>-<sha>-<date>.md. Batch capped at 5000 files; first cold run completes <300s, steady-state <60s. State at mcp-server/data/state/resources-weekly-scan.json.

Promote high-confidence tribal tip clusters (confidence >= 60, cluster_size >= 3) to knowledge/memories/reference/tribal-<topic>-YYYY-WW.md. Idempotent on ISO-week. Surfaces tribal knowledge as reference material for /weekly-synthesis to incorporate. Deterministic template synthesis (no LLM round-trip).

Render the cyrilXBT JARVIS feedback-loop monthly report (4 questions: topics-by-BPI, hook outperformance, untried angles, double-down combos) from knowledge/memories/published/ into knowledge/memories/inbox/perf-report-YYYY-MM.md. Calls performanceLoopEngine.monthlyReport(). 1st-of-month at 08:01 local gives prior month a clean publish-date floor.

Move sharpen-PASS notes (score >= 0.85, classification confident, dwell >= 24h) from knowledge/memories/inbox/ to their target subfolder (observations/reactions/patterns/questions/numbers). Closes the cyrilXBT capture-to-promote loop. Runs BEFORE prune (05:07) and BEFORE daily-brief (06:00) so inbox/ is clean by brief time.

Archive (cp + unlink) inbox/*.md files older than 48h to knowledge/memories/inbox/archived-stale/. Honors cyrilXBT 'inbox is for triage not storage' rule but softer than delete. Idempotent (already-archived files are skipped). Brief/perf-report files exempt.

Monthly skill-library quality audit (@eng_khairallah1 Phase-4 'how many of the ~500 skills are actually production-grade?'). Grades every skill in SKILL_QUALITY_REGISTRY.json against linter-clean + 3-Question-satisfied + all-three-scenario-tests-pass into production_grade / needs_refinement / stub_or_orphan; writes state/shared/SKILL-LIBRARY-AUDIT-YYYY-MM-DD.{md,json} with the per-domain breakdown, the prioritized gap list, top-N by invocation, and the ROI estimate. Idempotent on the date (re-run same-day overwrites). Engine: SkillLibraryAuditEngine; dispatcher: prism_dev:skill_audit. 1st-of-month 08:00 local.

Monthly community-skill-marketplace scan (@eng_khairallah1 Phase-1 'there are 80,000+ community Skills... most people have never installed one'). Fetches the major collections (anthropics/skills, wshobson/agents, obra/superpowers GitHub READMEs; skillsmp.com is JS-gated and skipped unless run with the Playwright MCP), scores each listing against PRISM's domain vocabulary, dedup-checks against the existing library, and writes state/shared/skill-marketplace-candidates-YYYY-MM-DD.{md,json} with install/study/already-covered/skip recommendations. RECOMMENDS ONLY — installing a community skill is a human/forge action through /harness-security-audit. Engine: SkillMarketplaceScannerEngine; dispatcher: prism_knowledge:skill_marketplace_scan. 1st-of-month 10:00 local.

Weekly skill-refinement digest (@eng_khairallah1 Phase-3 'review and refine your Skill every Friday for the first month'). Surfaces skills wanting attention this week in three categories: A output-overridden (telemetry; a hot-but-stale proxy until an override event type exists), B stale (last_refined > 90d; narrows to stale-AND-hot once invocation_count_30d is wired), C linter-flagged (from skill-lint-report.json). Each entry is enriched with the latest SKILL-LIBRARY-AUDIT grade/distance/suggested-fix. Writes state/shared/skill-refinement-digest-YYYY-MM-DD.{md,json} and posts a one-line summary to the agent chat bus. Read-only — refinement is a human/forge action (edit the SKILL.md; last_refined auto-updates from mtime). Engine: SkillRefinementDigestEngine; dispatcher: prism_dev:skill_refinement_digest. Friday 09:13 local (the @eng_khairallah1 'Friday reminder').
